Please set the status of your contributions to WIP to allow for a proper review and necessary adjustments before the contributions are opened for approval by others.

Formatting
* Please study the formatting syntax described on this page: https://www.codingame.com/playgrounds/40701/help-center/statement , and format the statement properly following the example there.

Cover picture
* Please upload a cover picture for the puzzle.

I'll perform a more detailed review after the statement has been formatted.

Thanks.
